vocabulary.meaning: one of the cells that make up blood, including red and white cells
examples: Red blood cells carry oxygen around the body.
Doctors counted the different blood cells in the sample.

vocabulary.meaning: the pale liquid part of blood that carries cells and other substances
examples: Plasma makes up more than half of blood by volume.
Some patients receive plasma during medical treatment.

vocabulary.meaning: a blood cell that carries oxygen from the lungs to the body
examples: A low red blood cell count can cause tiredness.

vocabulary.meaning: a blood cell that helps the body fight infection
examples: White blood cells are part of the immune system.
The infection caused an increase in white blood cells.

vocabulary.meaning: a small blood component that helps stop bleeding
examples: A very low platelet count can increase bleeding risk.

vocabulary.meaning: the protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen
examples: The test showed a low haemoglobin level.
Iron is needed to make haemoglobin.
